method: twin records on which the form shows the button and which agree on what its invisible expression reads and on state; the CLI on one, an independent web-client oracle (button context, wizard defaults by onchange, the operation's dialog answers) on the other; stored scalar fields compared before and after: the same fields changed, selections and booleans to the same values. Twins are sought inside the operation's provider domain. A chatter operation (a note, an activity) is compared by what each path left on its record: one new note or activity, the same in type, subtype, author, summary, user and deadline. A guarded delete runs on two fresh records inside its domain, one deleted through the CLI and one unlinked as the web client's Delete does: both gone, nothing else in the domain.
